registry.hashNormalization: Only registry and sharedRegistry source SHA256: UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalized to LF, matching repository eol=lf. All archive/PNG/metadata/RGBA/license hashes use original raw bytes.

nonPngPrimitive.note: Uppercase White is a plain material primitive, not a 64th original PNG. The separate lowercase white registry PNG remains one of the 63 original files.

boundaries: Every entry resolves its actual inline/shared URL and matches complete encoded PNG bytes in the pinned official ZIP; no cropping or image re-encoding.
RGBA hashes use the existing lossless source PNG decoder with CRC checks and preserve transparent RGB; not browser/PMA readback.
This provenance does not certify active resource packs, runtime bindings, geometry, fonts, native sampling, or whole-GUI pixel equality. No private font pages or capture data are included.

verification.generation: Omit --check to write this deterministic manifest; script never downloads or changes source files.
